d:
Bhide gets worried when Sonu doesn't return home after school, and Champaklal goes searching for Tapu. They find Tapu Sena at the clubhouse, where the kids reveal they found an envelope containing ₹25,000 on VP Road and want to return it to its rightful owner.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
